children: HDFC Bank Limited Sponsored ADR (NSE:HDFCBANK) reported modest Q2 profit with rising NII, higher deposits and improved asset quality even as treasury income fell and FCNR(B) inflows pressured margins; leadership changes and regulatory filings add governance focus amid analyst optimism.
Previous Week Recap
HDFC Bank ADR Net Profit Modestly Rose
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) Q2: net profit rose modestly; net interest income increased; treasury income fell; advances and deposits grew; gross NPA improved; provisions noted.
Anup Bagchi Succeeds Jagdishan As MD & CEO
: HDFCBANK: Anup Bagchi will succeed Sashidhar Jagdishan as MD & CEO on Oct 26. Traders watch margin pressure, stable asset quality, ROA below historic levels, and management continuity.
Basel III CAR 18.9%; Results Preview
: HDFCBANK: Basel III CAR 18.9% (Tier‑1 17.2%, CET1 17.1%), revenue Rs48,450cr, other income Rs13,830cr, cost-to-income 39.1%. Stock closed slightly higher before results.
Q2 FY2027 Deposits Jump; RBI Impact
: HDFCBANK Q2 FY2027: total deposits +18.8% YoY; CASA +10.8%, retail CASA +11.2%. RBI FCNR swap added ~4 ppt to CASA. Management said large unusual outflows masked deposit momentum.
MD & CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan Won’t Seek Third Term
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK): MD & CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan won’t seek a third term; current term ends Oct 26, 2026. Announcement made amid ongoing governance talks at the bank.
FCNR Deposits Via RBI Swap; Bonds Issued
: HDFC Bank ADR (HDFCBANK) mobilized $11.5B in FCNR(B) deposits via RBI swap window; overseas branches lent $5.7B against them and issued $2.5B in USD senior unsecured bonds.
HDFCBANK Holdings Inflexed; New Stake
: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund kept HDFCBANK holdings unchanged in Sept 2026. Abakkus Flexi Cap Fund added 400,000 HDFCBANK ADRs, raising its stake to 5,000,000 shares.
RBI Approval Sought For Chief Credit Officer
: HDFC Bank requested RBI approval in September 2026 to appoint Chief Credit Officer Jimmy Tata as Whole‑Time Director and Executive Director for a three‑year term; request submitted to regulator.
NIM Outlook Flat To Down Next Quarter
: Analysts expect HDFCBANK’s net interest margin to be flat or slightly down next quarter due to higher FCNR(B) deposit costs, with several brokers forecasting a modest margin decline.
JM Financial: Top Large-Bank Pick; 1% PAT Growth
: JM Financial picked HDFC Bank (HDFCBANK) as a top large‑bank pick, forecasting about 1% YoY PAT growth in Q2FY27, citing strong balance‑sheet growth offsetting NIM pressure from FCNR‑B inflows.
